summary: Definitive Healthcare Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing that its Special Committee received a non-binding going-private proposal from Advent International to acquire all outstanding Class A common stock and AIDH TopCo LLC units not already owned by Advent or founder/Executive Chairman Jason Krantz, at $1.02 per share/unit in cash. The Special Committee, composed of independent directors, will review the proposal with advisors. No board recommendation or transaction terms beyond price are stated. Watch for a definitive agreement, special committee evaluation, and potential competing bids, as the proposal is non-binding and undeveloped.
